# GitHub Copilot Instructions for GATE AE 2027 Obsidian Vault

When generating notes, formulas, PYQ solutions, or updating tracking files:
1. Always check `AI_CONTEXT.md` for current vault status and session history.
2. Follow `AGENTS.md` guidelines for note structure and tagging.
3. Ensure all links use Obsidian bi-directional link format: `[[Note Name]]`.
4. Prioritize Core Topics (≥90% of GATE 2027 exam) over Special Topics (≤10%).
